description: This file contains C++ code that defines Python bindings and internal classes for the PyTorch profiler, including custom Python types, profiling configuration classes, and functions for symbolizing tracebacks and managing profiling events.

classes.name: THPCapturedTraceback
classes.description: A Python object representing a captured traceback, holding a shared pointer to torch::CapturedTraceback.

classes.name: pybind11::detail::type_caster<std::shared_ptr<torch::CapturedTraceback>>
classes.description: A pybind11 type caster for converting between Python objects and shared pointers to torch::CapturedTraceback.

classes.name: torch::profiler::RecordFunctionFast
classes.description: A custom Python type for fast recording of profiling regions, used as a context manager.

methods.name: initPythonBindings
methods.description: Initializes Python bindings for the profiler module, defining classes, enums, and functions.

methods.name: gather
methods.description: Collects traceback information from Python, script, and C++ sources.

methods.name: symbolize_tracebacks
methods.description: Converts a list of traceback objects into symbolized frames.

methods.name: symbolize_addresses
methods.description: Converts a list of address frames into symbolized frame information.
